name: 70126 · New Orleans, LA
findings: ZIP 70126 (New Orleans) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70126 (New Orleans) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 22 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
